scripts.build: npm run build -w @openclog/core && npm run build -w @openclog/app && npm run build -w @openclog/api && npm run build -w @openclog/web && npm run build -w @openclog/desktop
scripts.docs:check: tsx scripts/run-and-record-verification.ts --label "npm run docs:check" -- npm run docs:check:raw
scripts.test:e2e: playwright test tests/e2e/openclog.spec.ts tests/e2e/theme-accessibility.spec.ts tests/e2e/interaction-refinements.spec.ts tests/e2e/advanced-features.spec.ts
scripts.test:visual: tsx scripts/run-and-record-verification.ts --label "npm run test:visual" -- npm run test:visual:raw
scripts.test:smoke: tsx scripts/run-and-record-verification.ts --label "npm run test:smoke" -- npm run test:smoke:raw
scripts.test:smoke:raw: vitest run apps/api/test/routes.test.ts apps/web/test/operator-workspace.test.ts && playwright test tests/e2e/advanced-features.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep "operations report empty state" && npm run smoke -w @openclog/desktop
scripts.test:changed: vitest run packages/app/test/application.test.ts apps/api/test/advanced-features.test.ts apps/web/test/operator-workspace.test.ts apps/web/test/ui-state.test.ts
scripts.test:workbench: vitest run packages/app/test/application.test.ts apps/api/test/advanced-features.test.ts apps/api/test/repository.test.ts apps/web/test/operator-workspace.test.ts apps/web/test/ui-state.test.ts
scripts.verify: tsx scripts/run-and-record-verification.ts --label "npm run verify" -- npm run verify:raw
scripts.verify:raw: npm run check:forbidden-rpc && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:visual && npm run test:redteam && npm run docs:check
scripts.verify:desktop-native: tsx scripts/run-and-record-verification.ts --label "npm run verify:desktop-native" -- npm run verify:desktop-native:raw
scripts.verify:gateway: tsx scripts/run-and-record-verification.ts --label "npm run verify:gateway" -- npm run verify:gateway:raw
